titulo_ja: おどろき と けっか (3)

かえって.es: al contrario de lo esperado; para peor
かえって.en: to the contrary of what was expected; for the worse;

つかれました.en: I was tired; I was tired.

bloques.titulo: In the past, the Commission has been able to take the necessary steps to ensure that the Commission is able to take the necessary measures to ensure that the Commission is able to take the necessary measures to ensure that it is able to achieve the objectives of this objective.
texto: He points out that the result was opposite or less favourable than expected: **やすみ な のに、 でかけたら かえって つかれました** (although it was my day off, when I got out I got tired more).
To present an option as preferable or more suitable in that situation: **つかれた ので、 むしろ ねたい です** (as I am tired, I prefer rather to sleep).

frases.ja: 休暇 に 何も しない つもり でした。ところが、家 で 一日中 寝ていたら、かえって 体 が 重く なりました。短い 散歩 を した ほう が 気分 が よく なります。
frases.es: Pensaba no hacer nada durante las vacaciones. Sin embargo, después de dormir todo el día en casa, me sentí aún más cansado. Dar un paseo corto mejora el ánimo.
frases.en: I thought I'd do nothing during the holidays. However, after sleeping all day at home, I felt even more tired. Taking a short walk improves your mood.

opciones.texto: That the result was contrary to what was expected, often for worse.
opciones.explicacion: It's not just an opposite direction.

intro: Finally, two words to say that something goes the other way than what is expected, or that one option is better than another. They're useful to give your opinion with nuances.
